name: gauge
description: Codex only: local token usage, prompt-cache reuse and estimated credits. ChatGPT conversations are not supported.

interface.longDescription: Gauge is currently available only for local Codex chats. ChatGPT conversations are not supported. Open a local Codex chat and ask: Open Gauge for this chat. Compare whole-chat, latest-call and latest-prompt cache reuse, recent history, and estimated credits from local Codex records. Python 3.11+ and uv are required; the host must support MCP Apps. Local logs may be incomplete and estimates are not billed usage or remaining allowance.
defaultPrompt: Open Gauge for this Codex chat. If this is a ChatGPT conversation, explain that Gauge currently supports Codex only.
